report_identity.report_title: Tianjin Development Holdings Limited Annual Report 2025

business_overview.one_sentence: Tianjin Development is a Hong Kong listed holding company with utilities, pharmaceutical, hotel, electrical and mechanical subsidiaries plus port services and elevators/escalators associates.
business_overview.revenue_model: Utilities and pharmaceutical subsidiaries generate consolidated revenue; port services and elevators/escalators contribute mainly through equity-accounted profits and dividends.
business_notes: 2025 pharmaceutical segment included a one-off special dividend of RMB279.45 million, equivalent to about HK$305.076 million.
Utilities revenue included government supplemental income of HK$102.126 million in 2025.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Reported operating cash flow was weak in 2023-2025, especially 2024. Before working-capital swings the business plus associate/JV dividend cash can support a positive distributable base, but the main-case cash-profit haircut is materially below 1.
